subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should OpenClaw adopt permanent question summaries, Skip, reconnect reconciliation, and web composer takeover as the supported cross-platform question contract, including the additive shared Apple transport methods?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes durable interaction behavior across four supported clients and adds public shared transport calls; source review cannot determine whether that product contract is the intended long-term direction.

options.title: Sponsor after native proof
options.body: Confirm this cross-platform interaction contract and require redacted iOS, macOS, and Android after-fix evidence before merging.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep the proven Control UI behavior and split native persistence, Skip, or transport-contract changes into separately owned follow-up work.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Hold the PR if permanent terminal summaries or composer takeover should not become the supported cross-platform behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after native proof
recommendation.body: Confirm this cross-platform interaction contract and require redacted iOS, macOS, and Android after-fix evidence before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed cross-platform implementation and are the strongest available routing contact in the supplied history.
